challenge.name: The Consent Gap
challenge.description: A new model version requires loyalty basket data, but the deployment pipeline lacks the governance controls to verify consent. #automation_alex# wants to push the automated deployment forward immediately to meet the promotion deadline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a manual review process to ensure legal compliance. #automation_alex# is open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but #requirements_reuben# will not accept any automated path without full audit trails.

output.content: I am prepared to accept a manual approval step in the deployment pipeline. This means we lose the full automation of the release process, but it keeps the system moving toward the promotion deadline. The manual gate will verify the consent flag before the new model version goes live. I accept this loss of speed because it allows us to integrate the loyalty basket data without halting the entire workflow. The trade is clear: we give up the seamless automated path in exchange for a controlled, compliant deployment that still meets our schedule.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up full automation and speed in exchange for a controlled, compliant deployment that meets the deadline.
